title: cloneDeep of a MutableDataFrame throws 'Cannot set property length ... which has only a getter' in Rspack/ESM builds
answers: TypeError: Cannot set property length of #<d> which has only a getter
Explore raw Prometheus list view crashes with two or more instant queries
cloneDeep on data frame fails in Rspack build
plugin cloneDeep(props.data) throws in strict mode
body:
Symptom: In Rspack builds, Explore's raw Prometheus view crashed with `TypeError: Cannot set property length of #<d> which has only a getter`. You need two or more instant queries to trigger it, because the merge transformation then returns a MutableDataFrame.
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/dataframe/MutableDataFrame.ts:MutableDataFrame derives `length` from the first field and only had a getter. lodash `cloneDeep` builds the clone from the prototype and then assigns every own enumerable key, including `length`. Rspack outputs ES modules, which always run in strict mode, so the bundled lodash throws on that assignment. Before, the write failed silently.
Fix pattern: add a setter that does nothing (`set length(_value: number) {}`) next to the derived getter, so generic copiers can write back the value they just read. Also don't deep-clone frames you only read: public/app/features/explore/PrometheusListView/RawListContainer.tsx:RawListContainer now uses `props.tableResult` directly.
Constraints: this applies to any class with getter-only accessors that core or plugins might pass to cloneDeep or a similar copier. Grafana shares its lodash copy with plugins, so a plugin calling `cloneDeep(props.data)` hits the same fault. MutableDataFrame is deprecated, but it still comes out of transformations like merge.
applies: Getter-only properties on data frame classes and any code that deep-clones panel/query data under Rspack/ESM builds
